title: Great app, good value for your money!
body: I really like this app for a couple of reasons, you can make notes with regard to your habits and you can customize your habits with your own photo. Last by not least there is no monthly fees, no annoying ads. Yes there is a small one time fee if you want more than 2 habits I think but compared to the other 2 dozen habit apps I looked at that charges that fee on a monthly basis, how they justify that I’ll never know. I’m happy with this app and it works great!

title: So good!
body: I don't rate apps. This one rocks!  I needed to order my life, break habits and create new ones and this app is very helpful. I like that I can have reminders only on certain habits but I still get prompted daily to check off my list. Not irritating. User friendly - great icons for habits and fluid customizing. I appreciate an app that allows you to try it first and only upgrade if the extra features benefit you - I did upgrade and so far works like a charm!

body:

author: Monser17

title: Great Design, Poor Performance
body:
The functions in the app work very well. It allows enough flexibility (in Upgraded version) and function needed. However, system stability seems to be a big issue. So far I found two problems: iphone version has error pop-up message that doesn't allow user to pay for an upgrade (I'm sure I am authorized to pay in App Store). While iPad allows you to pay, but it does not automatically sync over to the iphone either. This problem is still pending to be fixed. Then the iPad version starts freezing after I set up a few habits, I mean, froze completely once it's opened. I will report how their customer service responds.

Follow up report: customer service was quite reasonable, kept the promise of responding in 48 hours, and figured out the above issue. However, the freezing persists, and seems it only happens in Pro Version. Definitely need a bug fix update!!!
